_comment: Reference settings for the jobs-lakehouse pipeline. Free Edition users create the pipeline in the UI (see pipelines/README.md — this file documents exactly which values to pick). CLI users can adapt it for `databricks pipelines create`. Two things matter most: `schema` (NOT the legacy `target`) enables the default publishing mode so fully qualified table names in the source code can publish to jobs_silver AND jobs_gold from this one pipeline; `event_log` publishes the pipeline's event log into Unity Catalog so notebook 03 can query expectation metrics by table name.
name: jobs-lakehouse
